poster_title: AGENTIC RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION: A SURVEY ON AGENTIC RAG
authors: Aditi Singh, Abul Ehtesham, Tala Talaei Khoei, Saket Kumar
paper_info: Cleveland State University, The Davey Tree Expert Company, Roux Institute at Northeastern University, The MathWorks Inc; 2023

content: Surveys foundational principles and evolution of RAG paradigms.
Presents taxonomy of Agentic RAG architectures and frameworks.
Highlights applications in healthcare, finance, and education.
Examines practical implementation strategies, benchmarks, and ethical considerations.
Acknowledges challenges in scaling and optimizing performance.
panels.headline: Comprehensive exploration of Agentic RAG

content: LLMs revolutionized AI with human-like text generation and understanding.
Reliance on static data causes outdated or inaccurate outputs in dynamic scenarios.
RAG integrates real-time data retrieval, improving contextual relevance and accuracy.
Traditional RAG systems lack adaptability for multi-step reasoning and complex tasks.
Agentic RAG addresses these limitations through autonomous AI agents.
panels.headline: Static pre-training data leads to outdated outputs

content: Uses agentic design patterns: reflection, planning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration.
Dynamically manages retrieval strategies and iteratively refines contextual understanding.
panels.headline: Agentic RAG embeds autonomous AI agents

content: Retrieval module fetches relevant documents.
Generation module produces text based on retrieved information.
Agentic module enhances flexibility and adaptability.
panels.headline: Core components of RAG

content: Modular RAG for flexible design.
Graph RAG for structured data.
Multi-Agent Agentic RAG for complex task management.
panels.headline: Advanced RAG frameworks

content: Excels in scenarios requiring precision and adaptability.
Applications in healthcare, finance, and education show significant improvements.
panels.headline: Agentic RAG demonstrates unparalleled flexibility

content: Provides a comprehensive overview of Agentic RAG principles, taxonomy, and applications.
Highlights potential and challenges of integrating real-time data retrieval with generative AI.
Future work focuses on scaling, ethical decision-making, and performance optimization.
panels.headline: Agentic RAG represents a significant advancement
